column5: QtlFineMappingResult (susie, --seed 1); deep all.equal via rds_compare.R. Reproducible run-to-run on one machine; the x86/ARM CI matrix may need a looser rtol — calibrate from the first CI run. Re-baselined for PR #1422 (SuSiE L default 10, greedy-L off): the fit now uses a FIXED 10 single effects instead of a greedy search that settled on 5, so alpha is 10x200 and the diffuse PIP mass roughly doubles (sum 9.89 -> 19.53, median per-variant ratio 2.085 ~ 10/5). Same 400 variants in the same order, top variant unchanged (chr22:10456420:A:T), and the locus still yields no credible sets. Turning greedy off is what makes this platform-stable: with it on, the retained-effect count was 5 on macOS and 10 on Linux, a shape difference no tolerance could absorb. Re-baselined 2026-10-13: genomicRegion() is now the ANALYSIS WINDOW, stored at construction, rather than the derived span of the variants that survived QC -- the span is still available as range(x). The collection therefore carries a `region` mcols column and the per-row grange_start/grange_end are populated (previously NA on every path, because no caller passed `region` to postprocessFinemappingFits). Verified the ONLY change: with the `region` column and grange_* dropped, old vs new are all.equal at 1e-6. This is the CIS/gene path, which recorded no window at all before (fineMappingPipeline passed region=NULL, so .makeXRegions returned list(NULL)); it now records traitPos +/- cisWindow, the interval .fmResidGenoBlock actually slices X over. Re-baselined 2026-10-15 for the pecotmr published-output rework (resultWriters.R: writeFineMappingBed/writeSumStatsVcf -> exportToBed/exportToVcf). Verified no existing value moved: over the columns both versions carry and that were populated before, old vs new are all.equal at 1e-6. Adds the dataSource / standardized / z_supplied provenance columns. Re-baselined 2026-10-16 against the installed pecotmr 0.9.3: `standardized` is FALSE -> TRUE. It is DERIVED, not declared -- .fmRecordProvenance() reads .qtlScaleResiduals(), and residualizedGenotypes() scales each genotype column to unit variance unless told otherwise -- so TRUE is the correct value for a default QtlDataset fit and the old FALSE was wrong. Verified the only change: with that one column neutralised, old vs new are all.equal at 1e-6. Re-baselined 2026-10-27 for the pecotmr 0.9.3 release: Adds the per-variant posterior_theta column. Verified additive: all 25 per-variant columns both versions carry are all.equal at 1e-6 over the same 400 variants, and the 20 collection-level columns are unchanged.
